name: Kentucky Fried Chicken
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 servings based on 1 whole chicken (typical for 3-4 people in frying recipes) plus coating for multiple pieces.
Total time estimated at 45 minutes: ~10 min prep/mixing, 5 min rest, ~20-25 min frying in batches, plus draining; fryer preheat assumed included or minimal additional time.
Egg white listed and used, confirming egg allergen; no dairy ingredients present.
Wheat from flour; no barley/rye/oats, but wheat makes it not gluten-free.
Oil type unspecified beyond 'neutral frying' so soy allergen left null (could be soybean oil).
All other allergens confidently absent based on listed ingredients.
instructions:
Preheat fryer to 350°F. Thoroughly mix together all the spice mix ingredients.
Combine spice mix with flour, brown sugar and salt.
Dip chicken pieces in egg white to lightly coat them, then transfer to flour mixture. Turn a few times and make sure the flour mix is really stuck to the chicken. Repeat with all the chicken pieces.
Let chicken pieces rest for 5 minutes so crust has a chance to dry a bit.
Fry chicken in batches. Breasts and wings should take 12-14 minutes, and legs and thighs will need a few more minutes. Chicken pieces are done when a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part reads 165°F.
Let chicken drain on a few paper towels when it comes out of the fryer. Serve hot.

ingredients.assumptions: 1 whole chicken estimated at 2.5 lb (1134g) raw edible yield including bone and skin, typical for frying recipe; raw values used as base before frying.

ingredients.assumptions: 2 quarts neutral frying oil; estimated 100g absorbed by the chicken during frying (typical uptake for deep-fried battered chicken), remainder not consumed.
